question: Estimate the daily consumption of bottled cold drinks (soft drinks + juices + flavored milk) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Carbonated soft drinks + packaged juice + flavored milk + energy drinks? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian soft drinks market (carbonated): ~₹35,000 Cr (FY26); avg ₹40/litre = 8.7 billion litres/year.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Packaged juice market (Real, Tropicana, Paper Boat)

calculationFlow: Indian soft drinks market (carbonated): ~₹35,000 Cr (FY26); avg ₹40/litre = 8.7 billion litres/year.
Packaged juice market (Real, Tropicana, Paper Boat): ~₹6,000 Cr; avg ₹100/L = 600 million litres.
Flavored milk + dairy beverages (Amul Kool, NESTLÉ): ~₹4,000 Cr; ~400 million litres.
